catalog.title: See clothes on a body like yours
catalog.lead: Every garment shown with a real photo. Pick a model who looks like you, try the garment on with your photo or live, and find your size with an honest recommendation.

body.pick: Pick a model who looks like you
body.pickHelp: By height and shape. Change it any time; there's no right one.
body.chooseToSee: Pick a model below to see the garment on a real person.
body.aiPreview: AI-generated try-on over a real model
body.approxHelp: This is an instant approximate view. The AI try-on, with real drape and folds, takes up to a minute.
body.approxFailed: This garment cannot be placed with this model’s pose; try another one.
body.onePiece: This model wears a dress in the photo: the AI cannot change just one part. See the approximate view or pick another model.
body.handsInPockets: This model has their hands in their pockets: the AI cannot change the lower half. See the approximate view or pick another model.
body.generate: See the garment on this model
body.generateHelp: There is no try-on of this garment on this model yet. Generating it takes up to a minute.
body.generating: Dressing the model… this can take up to a minute.
body.generateBusy: The try-on engine is busy or out of quota for today. Please try again later.
body.generateFailed: The try-on could not be generated. Please try again.
body.notWearable: This item is not tried on a model: see the product photo.

note.similar-model: Real product photo. On a model, the image is generated by AI: it shows how it looks, not how it will fit you. That is what the size recommendation is for.
note.live-overlay: Quick preview: the garment photo is overlaid on your image, but it does not predict the real fit.
note.photorealistic: AI-generated image from your photo. The most realistic option, but texture and fit may not be exact.

live.intro: See yourself wearing it in real time: the sleeve follows your arm, your hands stay in front and the lighting matches your room.
live.privacy: We only ask for the camera (no microphone). No frame leaves your device unless you tap “Realistic photo” and accept.
live.quickPreview: Quick preview — for a more realistic result, use your photo
live.unsupportedGarment: This item does not have a measured cutout for the camera yet. Try the similar body or your photo.
live.ratiosReady: Proportions ready to refine your size (optional).

hint.no-body: Stand in front of the camera
hint.turn-front: Face the camera: the garment can't be worn from the back or in profile
hint.show-hips: Make sure your shoulders and hips are visible
hint.show-legs: Step back so your knees are visible
hint.show-feet: Step back so your feet are visible
hint.show-head: Make sure your head is visible

error.denied: We don't have permission to use the camera. You can enable it in your browser settings.
error.unavailable: We couldn't find an available camera.
error.unsupported: Your browser doesn't allow using the camera here.
error.model: We couldn't load the pose detector on this device.

live.qualityFull: Live view · arms and hands in front
live.realisticNote: “Save snapshot” stays on your device. “Realistic photo” takes a photo in 3 s and, if you accept, sends it to the AI engine for a photographic result.
live.measureNote: “Measure me with AI” sends a single photo after a countdown to estimate chest, waist and hips. It is not stored; the video never leaves your device.

photo.intro: Upload a photo to see a realistic AI-generated image. It's optional: you can buy without it.

checklist.title: Your photo, your rules
checklist.cropFace: I'll use the least identifiable photo possible: I can crop or blur my face in the next step.
checklist.neutralBackground: The background is neutral and shows no personal information.
checklist.onlyYou: Only I appear in the photo.
checklist.ttl: The photo and result are deleted automatically in {{hours}} hours, unless you save the result to your account.
checklist.noTraining: We never use your photo to train models without separate permission.
checklist.deleteAnytime: You can delete it at any time.

face.legend: What should we do with your face?
face.notFound: No face detected. You can crop manually from the top.

photo.readyToGenerate: Your photo is ready. Generation takes between 20 and 90 seconds.
photo.generatingHint: Feel free to check the size and reviews meanwhile.
photo.slow: This is taking longer than usual; we are still waiting for the result.
photo.resultAlt: Generated image of the garment on your photo
photo.resultNote: AI-generated image: shows how it looks, not how it fits. Texture may not be exact.

fallback.title: We couldn't generate the image right now
fallback.body: The service is slow or unavailable. Meanwhile, you can see the garment on a similar body or try it live.
fallback.quota: The free engine has used up today's quota. Try again later; meanwhile you can see the garment on a model.
fallback.notConfigured: AI try-on is not enabled on this server. You can see the garment on a similar body or try it live.
fallback.contentPolicy: The engine did not accept this photo. Try another full-body, front-facing, well-lit photo.
fallback.busy: The engine failed several times in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
fallback.timeout: The engines took too long to respond. You can retry in a moment.

error.tooBig: The image is too large (15 MB max).
error.unreadable: We couldn't read that image. Try JPG or PNG.
error.upload: We couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.

failed.title: Generation didn't finish
failed.body: Something was interrupted on the server. Your photo is still available: you can retry.
failed.missingPhoto: Your photo is no longer available (it may have expired or been deleted). Upload it again to try.

check.title: This photo may not give a good result
check.no-person: We cannot see a person in the photo.
check.multiple-people: There is more than one person. It works best with just one.
check.not-full-body: The whole body is not visible. It works best from head to knees or more.
check.not-frontal: It works best standing and facing the camera.
check.too-dark: The photo is dark or blurry. Try with more light.

limitation.complexPattern: Complex print: the pattern may not be reproduced exactly in the generated image.
limitation.looseFit: Loose garment: AI may only approximate how it drapes.
limitation.wideLeg: Wide-leg cut: the AI tries two versions and keeps the one that best keeps the wide leg.

fit.title: Is it my size?
fit.optionalHelp: Circumference in centimeters. The more you give, the more reliable the recommendation.
fit.usePose: Use the proportions the camera detected (numbers only, never the image) to reinforce the recommendation.
fit.remember: Remember my measurements on this device
fit.alternative: You're between two sizes; {{size}} could also work.
fit.overridden: You chose {{size}}. Your choice helps us improve recommendations for this brand.

error.height: Enter your height in centimeters (120 to 230).
error.generic: We couldn't calculate the size. Please try again.

basis.detailedChart: This garment has a detailed size chart
basis.betweenSizesLowStretch: You're between two sizes and the fabric barely gives: we suggest the larger one
basis.betweenSizesStretchy: You're between two sizes and the fabric is stretchy: we suggest the smaller one
basis.brandRunsSmall: Adjusted: shoppers of this brand usually pick one size up
basis.brandRunsLarge: Adjusted: shoppers of this brand usually pick one size down
basis.outsideChart: Your measurements fall outside this garment's chart: treat it as an approximation
basis.insufficientData: Not enough data for this garment: treat it only as a starting point
basis.estimatedFromPhoto: Measurements estimated by AI from your photo (approximate)
basis.estimatedFromWeight: Body estimated from your height and weight
basis.garmentMeasurements: Compared with the garment's real measurements in each size

fabric.cottonJersey: Soft cotton jersey with some stretch.
fabric.oxfordNoStretch: Oxford cloth with no stretch: fits exactly per the chart.
fabric.woolCoat: Wool cloth, designed to wear over other layers.

reviews.title: How it fit other people
reviews.barLabel: {{small}} say it runs small, {{fit}} true to size, {{large}} runs large
reviews.empty: No fit reviews for this garment yet.
reviews.thanks: Thanks! Your review helps others choose their size.

compare.title: Compare garments
compare.empty: You haven't saved any garments yet. From any garment, tap “Save to compare”.

account.title: Your account
account.optional: You don't need an account to try on clothes. It's only for saving results.

consent.title: Allow my photos to be used to improve the models
consent.body: Off by default. If you turn it on, you could help the fitting room work better for bodies like yours. You can withdraw it any time.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Your account, photos and saved results are truly deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.done: Account deleted: {{deletedObjects}} files and {{deletedSessions}} sessions removed.

error.exists: That email already has an account.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

looks.title: Your looks
looks.body: Saved only in this browser, with no account and no photos: just which garments and which model you picked.
looks.clear: Delete my looks from this browser

account.demoHint: Sign in as a sample person who already has a photo and measurements.

similar.title: Similar body
similar.body: We ask for nothing: no photo, no camera, no measurements. It's the default mode.

live.title: Live camera
live.body: All processing happens in your browser. We only ask for video (never audio) and the camera turns off as soon as you leave. No image is sent to any server; the detection model is downloaded from our own site.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.body: Before uploading you can crop or blur your face, and we strip metadata (such as location). The photo and result delete themselves in {{hours}} hours unless you save the result to your account. You can delete it sooner whenever you want.

measurements.title: Your measurements
measurements.body: Only height is required. We don't store your measurements on the server; on your device only if you tick “remember”.

training.title: Model training
training.body: We never use your photos to train models without separate permission, which is off by default.

deletion.title: Real deletion
deletion.body: Deleting your account removes your files from storage, not just a flag in the database.

body.title: Your body, as it is
body.body: We offer no filters or tweaks to alter your silhouette, and we never compare bodies between people. Our reference body catalog covers XS to 4XL.

admin.title: Dashboard

m.overrideHelp: How often people change the suggested size.
m.fallbackHelp: Generations that ended in an alternative.
m.noBodyTime: We don't measure time spent looking at one's own body: that would optimize the wrong thing.

admin.name: Name
admin.chartNote: Created with the standard XS–4XL size chart. The photo is required: the store never shows a garment without a real photo.
admin.bodiesRule: Product rule: the catalog must always cover XS to 4XL. The system won't let you delete a body if it breaks that coverage.
admin.photoTypeFlat: On its own (flat or on a hanger)
admin.suggested: Style, colour and photo type suggested by AI from the image. Please review them.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a row. Please wait a moment.
errors.generationSlow: Generation is taking longer than usual. It is still running: we will show the result as soon as it arrives.
errors.deletePhoto: Couldn't delete the photo. Please try again.
errors.deleteAccount: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
errors.measure: Could not estimate your measurements. Your size still comes from your height.

credits.title: Photo credits
credits.lead: Garment and people photos come from Pexels, under its free licence. Thanks to their authors. They were cropped and given a new background for the store.

look.title: Build your look
look.lead: Pick one garment per slot and see it on instantly, on a model similar to you or on your camera. Suggestions pair color and style with fixed rules; you decide.
look.dressCovers: The dress already covers the bottom.
look.linkManual: Couldn't copy: copy the address from the browser bar.
look.cameraEmpty: Pick at least one garment with a cutout to see it on your camera.
look.open: Build a look with this garment

describe.empty: No garments in the look yet.

gallery.label: More views of the garment
gallery.zoomHelp: Tap or click to zoom in; move the pointer to look around. Esc to close.

measure.needHeight: First enter your height in “Is it my size?”: the AI uses it as scale.
measure.done: Measurements estimated: your size has been updated.
measure.unusable: The AI could not measure with this photo. Check the notice and try another one.
measure.aiNote: They are approximate (±5 cm) and count less than the ones you type. You can correct them in “Edit measurements”.
measure.unavailable: AI measuring is not available right now. Your size comes from your height and measurements.

reason.no-person: We cannot see a person in the photo.
reason.multiple-people: There is more than one person: use a photo with just one.
reason.not-full-body: Measuring needs the whole body, from head to feet.
reason.not-frontal: To measure, stand facing the camera.
reason.baggy-clothes: Very loose clothes hide the silhouette: try more fitted clothes.
reason.unknown: Could not measure with this photo.

profile.title: My profile
profile.lead: Optional. Save your photo and measurements so size, camera and photo try-on adapt to you instantly.
profile.photoNote: Full-body photo, facing forward. Only you can see it; it is deleted when you withdraw consent or delete your account.
profile.aiApplied: The AI estimated the missing measurements (marked “AI”).
profile.aiBadgeHelp: Estimated by AI from your photo. If you correct it, yours wins.
profile.consent: I consent to storing my photo and measurements in my account. I can withdraw it at any time and they are deleted.
profile.saved: Profile saved: your size has been updated.
profile.withdraw: Withdraw consent and delete my profile
profile.withdrawBody: Your stored photo and measurements will be deleted. Your account stays active.

error.range: A measurement is outside a reasonable range.

cart.title: Bag
cart.lead: Try on together what you are buying: one item per area (shirt, trousers, jacket, shoes…).
cart.oneBySlot: You can buy two shirts, but the fitting room wears one per area: picking another replaces the previous one, and a dress takes both shirt and trousers.
cart.wornNone: You are not wearing anything: press “Try it on” on an item.
cart.already: It is already in your bag in that size.

ai.lead: The AI will dress your photo with these {{count}} items, one after another:
ai.nothing: Wear at least a shirt, trousers, dress or jacket for the AI version.
ai.instantOnly: Accessories only show in the instant views: the AI cannot dress them yet.
ai.privacy: I understand the photo is used only for this try-on and deletes itself within 24 hours.
ai.workingHint: Each item takes about a minute. You can keep browsing your bag.
ai.failed: Could not generate the outfit. Try another photo or use the instant fitting room.
ai.finishNote: Finally, an AI retouch puts on the shoes, makes the fabric look real and shows how your chosen size fits.

favorites.title: My favorites
favorites.lead: Outfits you tried on with AI and saved: how each item looks when worn, and in which size.
favorites.signIn: Sign in to see your favorite outfits.
favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Try an outfit with AI in the cart and save it.
favorites.disclaimer: AI images generated from a real photo: a guide to drape and size, not a substitute for trying the item on.

one.title: No retouching
one.text: We never slim or reshape your silhouette: the garment adapts to you, not the other way round.

two.title: Honest sizing
two.text: We recommend a size from your measurements and tell you how sure we are.

three.title: Your photo is yours
three.text: The live camera never leaves your device and your photos expire on their own.

camera.title: Live
camera.text: With your camera: the garment follows your moves instantly.

photo.title: With your photo
photo.text: Upload a full-body photo and see how it fits you.

look.title: Build your look
look.text: Combine top, bottom, jacket and shoes into one outfit.

ai.title: From your photo to the full outfit
ai.text: The AI dresses you piece by piece, gives the fabric a real drape, puts the shoes on and shows whether the size fits snug or loose.
